Us

Why you're the best

  • The confidence

    You walk in like you own the room, and somehow you always do.

  • The honesty

    You say it straight. No games, no sugarcoating, and I love that about you.

  • The main character

    Every room you are in has a plot, because you are in it.

  • The creativity

    Architecture student, aesthetic queen. You see beauty in everything.

  • The five years

    Since class 9, and I am forever grateful.

19 wishes for 19

  1. 1May your confidence never take a day off.
  2. 2May you keep saying it straight, even when it is awkward.
  3. 3May your main character moments come with great lighting.
  4. 4May every outfit hit like that black saree.
  5. 5May your hair, skin and mood all behave.
  6. 6May your gallery stay full of good days.
  7. 7May the people who do not get you stay far away.
  8. 8May the right ones get you instantly.
  9. 9May your studio deadlines be kind and your models never collapse.
  10. 10May the cake always be bigger than the plan.
  11. 11May you win every argument you are right about.
  12. 12May you never shrink to fit a room.
  13. 13May good news find you before you go looking.
  14. 14May you laugh until it hurts at least once a week.
  15. 15May you trust your gut, because it is usually right.
  16. 16May you get everything you have been quietly working for.
  17. 17May the distance between us stay just a number.
  18. 18May nineteen be your loudest year yet.
  19. 19May I be there for the next one, cake in hand.

Your year 19 forecast

Five years

You are my best friend, and I am forever grateful for you. Five years since class 9 and you are still the one I want in every plan, every story and every photo.

I wish I was there for your birthday. I am stuck in my college hostel in Bhopal, but I am celebrating you from here, loudly. Thank you for being exactly who you are.

Happy 19th birthday, Tanishka 🎂
